fields.gate_position_u: Unclipped (target_x-line_extent[0])/(line_extent[1]-line_extent[0]) for horizontal gates; target_y for vertical gates. Target is first observed entry, not physical line intersection.
fields.actual_line_intersection_native_px: Always null: no physical intersection is inferred.
fields.source_annotation_interpolation: Always unknown_not_provided: the original GT rows do not identify interpolation or manual estimation.
fields.derivation_interpolation_used: False refers only to this generator; it makes no claim about source annotation.
fields.support_frame_interval_one_based: Original observed source and target GT frames; not a statistical uncertainty interval.
fields.unobserved_native_frames_in_support: Exact frozen transition count; no missing position is filled.
fields.invalid_point_observations_in_support: Original GT-ID rows whose boundary rule makes the foot invalid, kept separate from absent rows.
fields.human_qc: Always not_reviewed. Rule-confirmed labels have not yet been checked by two people.
